description: Use this tool ONLY to create live Digital Product Twins in Cycle without publishing passports or QR codes (for twin + passport + QR in one step use publish_product_passports instead). from its product data (after validating with validate_dpp_readiness). INPUT: array of products (same flexible shape as validate_dpp_readiness). OUTPUT: per product, a persistent id and a LIVE twin URL (scannable product page), plus DPP readiness and missing fields. Uses the connected Cycle account (OAuth or organization key); never request keys in chat. Up to 100 products per call.

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string for this request; repeating it returns the first result instead of creating a duplicate.

products.description: Array of product objects in any shape (name, sku, gtin, composition, country, care, materials...).

name: create_product_twin
